notes.title: Guided Home
notes.notes:
We've heard your feedback and understand the frustration some of you have experienced trying to navigate the forest while avoiding those overly affectionate monkeys. 

To make your journey a little easier, your friend has now given you a special map to guide you home as quickly as possible. 

We've made updates to the map and the map button to improve your pathfinding experience. With this new addition, we hope you'll be able to evade the monkeys and reach safety without delay!
